candidates.formal_type:
∀ (m : Nat) (α : Fin m → Complex),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), IsAlgebraic.{0, 0} Rat (α i)) →
    ∀ (β : Complex),
      IsConjRoot.{0, 0} Rat (Finset.sum.{0, 0} Finset.univ.{0} fun i => α i) β →
        Exists.{1} fun α' =>
          And (∀ (i : Fin m), IsConjRoot.{0, 0} Rat (α i) (α' i))
            (Eq.{1} β (Finset.sum.{0, 0} Finset.univ.{0} fun i => α' i))

source_text: Every algebraic conjugate of a finite sum of algebraic numbers is a sum of chosen conjugates of the summands.
